name: CRediT Matrix
description: CRediT Matrix helps a research team draft the CRediT (Contributor Roles Taxonomy) contribution statement for a paper with its co-authors. Co-authors fill in their own rows through a shared link, can sign their reply with ORCID, and their replies are settled in one review. Contributors can be added from an ORCID iD, a DOI or a tenzing sheet, and an existing statement can be pasted in to fill the grid. The tool exports a contribution heatmap and the statement as JATS4R XML, a Crossref contributors block, CSV, a tenzing sheet, JSON or Markdown. Beside the grid it shows how often published papers in a field give each role, and a census page shows how 8.2 million open-access articles in Europe PMC use CRediT. The web app works offline in nine languages. The credit-matrix npm package adds a command-line tool, a credit-matrix web element, and Quarto and MyST plugins.
